source.name: City National Bank – 'Royal Bank of Canada and Subsidiary City National Bank Announce Jersey Partnership With the LA Galaxy and Founding Partnership With Dignity Health Sports Park'
source.quote: The RBC shield will be prominently featured on the right sleeve of the LA Galaxy's official primary and secondary jerseys

note: Multiyear jersey sleeve partnership beginning with the 2025 MLS season, brokered by AEG Global Partnerships; the sleeve logo is the RBC shield. Sister subsidiary City National Bank is the club's official bank and a Dignity Health Sports Park founding partner, but the jersey mark is RBC's. No reported value.
